<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask api-catalog` from services/*/openapi.json. Do
     not edit: `cargo xtask api-catalog --check` refuses a page that differs. -->

Every service serves its own document at `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`, and
commits the same document as `services/<svc>/openapi.json`; a test per
service holds the committed file to the routes it mounts, and every `/api/v1`
route is mounted with its document entry. The files below are those
documents — generate a client from one, or point any OpenAPI viewer at it.
A refusal is the shared `ApiError` body: branch on its `code`.
